reviews.review: Awesome game for up to 4 players! Great art, great music and great gameplay!
Harder than 2, much more janky, but very fun.

This game is so much fun, crisp and clear sprites, fun items fun synergies between items/characters, amazing music, MULTIPLAYER, tons of secrets and very challenging but extremely fun gameplay.
Enemies have difficult to avoid attacks that require your attention to learn and avoid, plenty of attacks may feel impossible to avoid but if you slow down and focus on that enemy you'll figure it out.
Finding new characters is sometimes easy and simple but sometimes it's very difficult to find them and subject to RNG.
Keep that in mind, this game can be fun to play casually with friends but it'll kick your butt for awhile before you get there.
There are melee characters and DO NOT sleep on them, my favorite characters are melee (miner and mercenary)

I'm very excited for the Risk of Rain remake that's coming so I came to play this original (and the sequel briefly) and I was just as happy to play the first one again.
RoR2 very disappointing to me, 3d graphics didn't translate well with the crisp and clear gameplay, RoR1 is incredible

It doesn't seem like I, the player, have any bearing on the outcome of each run. It feels like I'm just waiting for the game to give me a bunch of specific item drops so that I may progress.

Skill/learning has no bearing on if you win or lose.

Edit, Feb 17, 2025: I figured out how to play the game. First, rush to the teleporter (take note of all upgrade chests) and turn it on. Now run away and kill whatever enemies you want. Use the money to buy all the chests, upgrades, drones, etc. Kill all enemies. Rinse and repeat. The priority list is: Reduce time spent on a level, get all upgrades/lootables, and then kill enemies.

Its one of those games where its really not clear what the game is intending for you to do, or what types of things the game rewards and penalizes.
